passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I have a friend, and his name is Tom.
phrases.ko: 나에게는 친구가 있고, 그의 이름은 톰이에요.

phrases.en: We are in the same class.
Tom can be kind, and he is a good friend.
phrases.ko: 톰은 친절할 수 있고, 좋은 친구예요.

phrases.en: We share a snack when we are hungry.
His name is easy, and I like to say it.
phrases.ko: 그의 이름은 쉽고, 나는 그 이름을 부르는 것이 좋아요.

phrases.en: We sit in the same row at school.
A good friend listens and waits.
Tom and I walk home after soccer.
phrases.ko: 톰과 나는 축구 후에 집에 걸어서 가요.

phrases.en: I share my snack because he shares his.
phrases.ko: 톰이 간식을 나눠 주어서 나도 나눠요.

phrases.en: I am glad we are in the same class.

full_passage_spoken: I have a friend, and his name is Tom. We are in the same class. Tom can be kind, and he is a good friend. We play soccer after school. We share a snack when we are hungry. His name is easy, and I like to say it. We sit in the same row at school. A good friend listens and waits. Tom and I walk home after soccer. I share my snack because he shares his. I am glad we are in the same class.
